gates.requiredEvidence: MIDI-driven voice lifetime, old-voice selection, pedal state and update scheduling
gates.remaining: MIDI supplies repeat ages, primary Rattle and key-release controls and, in the complete shared-route replay, contribution frames and own cache heads. gates.requiredEvidence: Own complete voice sources, feedback, auxiliary inputs, convolution plans and final stereo
gates.remaining: A complete same-run shared-routing replay computes MIDI contribution frames, ages and cache heads, with 4720852 checks and zero differences per accepted run. Final voice audio, routing maps/geometry, contributor order and global call coverage remain observed; downstream feedback, convolution and final stereo are not yet independently closed.

gates.requiredEvidence: Explain and isolate native variation without aligning, cropping, normalizing or enlarging tolerances
gates.remaining: A complete paired route-entry/shared-cache experiment has equal per-voice audio and maps but 1242 different shared float32 words. Swapping only native contribution order reproduces both complete shared outputs exactly in both directions. Full final PCM propagation and other variability, including changed strike initialization, remain unresolved; this gate stays open.
